newsitem.title: CANADA: Alliance makes preliminary filing with Canada NEB.
newsitem.headline: Alliance makes preliminary filing with Canada NEB.

text.p: Alliance Pipeline, a group of Canadian energy firms aiming to build a gas pipeline to Chicago from northern Canada, said on Thursday it filed a preliminary submission for the C$3.6-billion project with Canada's National Energy Board.

Alliance said the preliminary filing was intended to alert the NEB that the consortium would will apply for a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity in mid-1997 for permission to construct and operate the Canadian portion of the line.

The submission also requested that the NEB initiate activities before receiving the CPCN rquest to ensure the board's obligations under the Canadian Environmental Assessment Act are carried out "on an expeditious basis," Alliance said.

The consortium, which includes 18 companies including Alberta Energy Co Ltd, Gulf Canada Resources Ltd and IPL Energy Inc, hopes to have the 1.25 billion cubic feet per day pipeline on stream in 1999.
Alliance filed its application covering the United States portion of the project with the U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission on December 24. ((-- Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
